source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 924 filters out cards without _href before constructing the full-fetch comparison map. The newer accepted _getCardsByHref helper normalizes the href, keeps only a truthy result and builds a fresh map for each comparison. Full fetch removes known remote hrefs it sees and deletes only the remaining map entries. Cards without a usable remote href are outside that remote-presence deletion set. Do not infer that this class never deletes or uploads those cards through another path.
title: Index only cards with a usable remote href during reconciliation
